In that moment, I felt an overwhelming sense of forgetfulness. I forgot what it was like to feel fully charged, to be present in the moment, and to take care of myself. It was a harsh realization, and it reminded me of the importance of being mindful and remembering to take care of myself, even in the midst of excitement and passion.
